github.note: Merge of pajicadvance PR #56 (26.3 update); the published JAR has no sources JAR, so this branch head is a source reference matched against the binary below.

port_comparison.result: Registry IDs, block-state properties (facing, orientation), items, recipes, tags, models, textures and lang files are identical apart from CRLF line endings. Class bytecode matches except ChalkMarkBlock: the official build overrides spawnDestroyParticles(Level,BlockPos,BlockState) (Level.destroyBlock path) and keeps a no-op playerDestroy override; the port overrode spawnDestroyByEntityParticles(Level,Entity,BlockPos,BlockState), which also covers the player-break path. chalk-compat restores the player-break effect without modifying this JAR.
port_comparison.saved_data: Existing chalk marks and chalk items load unchanged: identical namespaced IDs and block-state definitions.
